description: This file defines classes and functions for managing and interacting with Spark Structured Streaming queries, including the StreamingQuery and StreamingQueryManager classes, with methods for controlling query execution, retrieving status, and handling events.

classes.name: StreamingQuery
classes.description: Represents a handle to a continuously running Spark streaming query, providing methods to control and monitor the query.

classes.name: StreamingQueryManager
classes.description: Manages active Spark streaming queries, allowing retrieval, monitoring, and event handling.

methods.name: StreamingQuery.id
methods.description: Returns the persistent unique identifier of the query.

methods.name: StreamingQuery.runId
methods.description: Returns the non-persistent unique run identifier for the current query instance.

methods.name: StreamingQuery.name
methods.description: Returns the user-defined name of the query.

methods.name: StreamingQuery.isActive
methods.description: Indicates whether the query is currently active.

methods.name: StreamingQuery.awaitTermination
methods.description: Blocks until the query terminates or the optional timeout expires.

methods.name: StreamingQuery.status
methods.description: Returns the current status of the query as a dictionary.

methods.name: StreamingQuery.recentProgress
methods.description: Returns a list of recent progress updates for the query.

methods.name: StreamingQuery.lastProgress
methods.description: Returns the most recent progress update or None.

methods.name: StreamingQuery.processAllAvailable
methods.description: Blocks until all available data has been processed.

methods.name: StreamingQuery.explain
methods.description: Prints the logical and physical plans for debugging.

methods.name: StreamingQuery.exception
methods.description: Returns the exception if the query terminated with an error.

methods.name: StreamingQueryManager.active
methods.description: Returns a list of active streaming queries.

methods.name: StreamingQueryManager.get
methods.description: Retrieves an active query by its ID.

methods.name: StreamingQueryManager.awaitAnyTermination
methods.description: Waits for any query to terminate.

methods.name: StreamingQueryManager.resetTerminated
methods.description: Clears the record of past terminated queries.

methods.name: StreamingQueryManager.addListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for query lifecycle events.
